audience_knowledge_evolution.established_belief: The Bat is an elusive master criminal terrorizing the city, while Miss Cornelia Van Gorder moves into Oakdale Manor unaware of any connection to ongoing bank thefts.
A major bank robbery has occurred and suspicious individuals, including disguised bank clerk Brooks and Dr. Wells, are searching Oakdale Manor for hidden loot or secret blueprints.
Detective Anderson has arrived at Oakdale Manor to lead the official police investigation, secure the property, and apprehend the elusive Bat.

validated_reveals.title: Detective Anderson is Unmasked as 'The Bat'

validated_reveals.previous_belief: Detective Anderson is a dedicated police detective leading the investigation to capture The Bat.
validated_reveals.revealed_fact: Detective Anderson is himself 'The Bat', using his official position to orchestrate terror and locate the stolen money.
